decision.rationale: Time limit: TXN-007865 was posted on 2026-07-27 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22. That is 87 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Amounts: the posted amount is 195243 cents (1952.43 EUR). The authorised amount on AUTH-008077 is also 195243 cents, for an approved e-commerce payment with 3-D Secure authenticated. No receipt or quote is attached. The cardholder says they were quoted 1210.51 EUR, a difference of 74192 cents, but that is their claim, not a document from the merchant. Under amount-no-receipt, with no receipt and the posted amount equal to the authorised amount, nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. The next step is to ask the merchant for the receipt or order details. No credit is proposed at this stage.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt, quote or order details for the card transaction of 1952.43 EUR made on 2026-07-26 (posted 2026-07-27). They should show the amount the cardholder agreed to pay and what the charge covers.
